comment: Same-model (--base/--test) comparison points. Each target is a subroutine present in both binaries; a plain string means the same symbol on both sides, and per-side symbols exist for deliberate renames (refactors). step_sentinel names a once-per-timestep subroutine used to tag hits and auto-terminate the runs (default cam_run1; CTSM would use clm_drv). The optional capture table is the capture-v1 types shape: derived-type dummies of these types expand into per-component pseudo-args, so a per-model preset is one file.
